annotations.title: Send a request to a licensed real estate agency

description: Passes the person's request to buy or sell a home in Portugal to a licensed real estate agency (AMI), only with their explicit consent. Use it when the person wants a specialist to contact them; for emails about new projects use `subscribe_digest`. mode=link only returns the form link and the consent text. mode=prepare checks the details and returns a summary, the GDPR (RGPD) consent text and a confirmation_token; neither sends anything. Show the person the summary and the consent text word for word; only if they explicitly agree, call mode=submit with the same details, the token, consent=true and consent_text_version. Never set consent=true on your own. Changed details, a token younger than 5 seconds or older than 30 minutes, or an outdated consent version are refused. A submit that goes through returns status received.

budget.description: Optional. Budget in whole euros, e.g. 350000

channel.description: How the person wants to be contacted on that phone

city.description: Municipality in Portugal (Lisboa or Lisbon) or a district. Not needed with project, which sets the place

client.description: Optional. Your app's host or name: recorded as the request's source

confirmation_token.description: submit only: the token returned by prepare

consent.description: submit only: true once the person has read the consent text returned by prepare and explicitly agreed

consent_text_version.description: submit only: consent_text_version returned by prepare

email.description: Only if the person gives no phone

intent.description: Optional. visit and reserve only with a project on sale, notify only with a project not yet on sale

language.description: The person's language: the consent text, the emails and the page links come in it. Another value is refused, except in mode=link, which falls back to English. uk is accepted as ua.

examples: Close to the metro, with a balcony

mode.description: link: only the form link and the consent text. prepare: check the details, get a summary, the consent text and a confirmation_token; nothing is sent. submit: send the request — the same details as in prepare plus confirmation_token, consent=true and consent_text_version, only after the person has read the consent text and explicitly agreed

phone.description: Phone in international format. Preferred over email

preferred_time.description: Optional, with intent=visit: when suits the person

project.description: Optional. Slug of the development the request is about: the slug field of search_newbuilds

property_type.description: apartment if not given, or new_build when project is given

typology.description: Optional. Bedroom counts wanted (T2 = two bedrooms)

name: request_consultation

anyOf.description: mode=link: the form link and the consent text; nothing is sent.
mode=prepare: summary, consent text and token; nothing is sent.
mode=submit: the request was received and passed on.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Send a request to a licensed real estate agency
